final_lifecycle_correction.description: Two Central-authored lazy-adapter lifecycle corrections, finished and qualified in this campaign (no repeated GPU/Graphiti campaign).

corrections.idle_retry_no_optional_schema: LazyCoreAdapter.retry_pending now short-circuits to 0 when the temporal_validation_results table is absent, so an idle worker tick creates no optional Graphiti/temporal tables when no work exists (test_idle_retry_does_not_create_optional_graphiti_tables).
corrections.validator_digest_invalidated_at_boot: build_runtime now invalidates a previously active temporal_validator_active digest at bootstrap (UPDATE only an existing identity table; no optional tables introduced into a fresh database), so a reconfigured validator loses recall authority at boot, not only at first submit/poll (test_reconfigured_validator_invalidates_old_active_digest_at_boot).

codex_p1_validator_authority.description: Centrally implemented validator-authority correction: the selected validator SHA is now an EXPLICIT bootstrap decision (temporal_ledger.select_active_validator), decoupled from the lazy ledger constructor, fencing overlapping runtimes so an earlier adapter's delayed first poll/submit/retry cannot restore its obsolete SHA.

corrections.explicit_bootstrap_selector: temporal_ledger.select_active_validator(db, sha) persists exactly one temporal_validator_active singleton (BEGIN IMMEDIATE; CREATE IF NOT EXISTS + upsert) and is called by build_runtime at exclusive bootstrap. Ingestion receipts, temporal result and contract tables remain deferred.
corrections.ledger_constructor_never_selects: TemporalLedger.__init__ no longer INSERTs the active validator; schema init may create the ordinary tables but never updates validator selection, so an old lazy runtime initializing after a newer bootstrap cannot restore its SHA.
corrections.stale_results_unverified: status_for_episode/evaluate return UNVERIFIED when the active singleton differs from the row's bound validator_sha256, so a historical SHA-A PASS result is not reauthorized; read-only retry_pending joins on both the row and the active singleton so A's retry is a no-op under B.
